name: EPIC 205961165

text.card: A red giant 4,649 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.89 solar masses and 16.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,861 K at its surface.
